prose: Josh and Adam Bigelsen are researchers and health consultants who have carried on the work of their father, Harvey Bigelsen, in the innovative field of what they call Holographic Blood. In the Bigelsen methodology, blood is examined under the microscope, and reveals messages from the body about what's going on with one's well-being.
ext: We dispel nano-tech narratives, focusing on solutions, accidents vs. in-see-dents, consciousness proceeding effects, communicating with the body, adaptable bacteria, holographic environments, homotoxicology, and more.
